app.title: Secret Garden
transfer.intake.title: Send · Intake
transfer.intake.lead: All books come in here: web upload, or scp into inbox. Stored as-is, never modified — optimize them first on your computer with sheng-ren (xochitl mode), then add them to xochitl from the master library.
transfer.intake.usbHint: For big books, use USB https://10.11.99.1 — doesn't use Wi-Fi.

transfer.upload.hint: EPUB / PDF only; other files are rejected.
transfer.staging.title: Master library
transfer.staging.optDetailsSummary: Where books are optimized · why masters are kept
transfer.staging.optNote: The shelf never modifies books: layout, notes, comic margins and covers are done on your computer with sheng-ren's xochitl mode; here they are added to xochitl as-is. Comics carrying sheng-ren's margin marker get minimal margins the first time they are opened. Masters are kept so you can add them again after switching devices; delete the ones you no longer need.

transfer.staging.emptyAll: (master library is empty — go to "Intake" to bring books in)
transfer.staging.delivered.native.staleT: The master file changed after it was added to xochitl (modified later than the add); xochitl still has the old version. Re-adding creates a new copy — remove the old one yourself.
transfer.staging.delivered.native.title: Already added to xochitl
transfer.staging.render.pendingTitle: Waiting for xochitl to finish rendering after adding, to auto-check the page count (up to 10 minutes)
transfer.staging.render.noneTitle: No render result from xochitl within 10 minutes (reading is unaffected; the page count just isn't recorded here). Don't re-add to re-check — that would create a second copy in xochitl.
transfer.staging.stalePending.title: A service or device restart interrupted the last run — the status got stuck at "in progress" and was never updated. It is not still running; please retry.
transfer.guide.summary: How does the master library work? (click to expand)
transfer.guide.steps.dd: ① Intake: upload or scp into inbox; the book is stored as-is in the master library. ② Add to xochitl: select books and click “Add to xochitl”. Masters are kept, so you can add them again any time.
transfer.guide.format.dd: Only {native} — convert other formats on your computer first. Books over ~90MB go through the large-file path and are added whole (placeholder first, then swapped for the real file; up to 1GB).
transfer.guide.native.dd: The book appears in the folder you chose in the xochitl library. Read it with the built-in reader: TOC jumps, footnotes, font changes, handwritten annotations; highlighter marks and nearby handwriting can be organized and sent to AI in the Notes tab.

assets.uiFont.title: xochitl · interface font
assets.uiFont.hint: Changes the font of the xochitl interface; reading is unaffected: these fonts are not added to the reader's font menu and are not used as the CJK fallback inside books. The two choices below cover the interface's regular text (menus, settings, file names, dialogs, buttons) and its titles. Upload below and pick one; takes effect after a full device reboot. Regular, semibold, bold and other files of the same font are shown as one row with the file count; the interface uses regular, medium and bold, so upload all of them — with only regular, bold text is synthesized and looks blurry on e-ink.

notes.title: Notes
notes.lead: Highlight and write next to it, close the book, then go to Browse: “Add to notes” transcribes it and sends it to Organize for review; “Not needed” skips it. Models and keys are set in Manage → Models.
notes.rescanTitle: Clear the page record and re-ingest the whole book
notes.trash.lead: Entries marked “Not needed” or “Remove”, plus entries revoked automatically after their strokes were erased. They are left out of the notebook and Obsidian, but kept until you empty the trash. On restore, “Not needed” entries go back to Browse; others return to Reviewed, Draft or Pending depending on what is left, or to Browse if nothing is.
notes.trash.purgeTitle: Permanently remove the entries listed below — cannot be undone
notes.import.lead: Separate from Browse / Organize: turns one .md file into a new device notebook in the current book's folder. Headings, lists and to-dos use the device's own styles; inline bold/italic markers are just removed; checked to-dos become unchecked.

notes.review.lead: Reviewed entries come back after a while: first one day after you finalise them, then “Remembered” stretches the gap to 3, 7, 16, 35 and 90 days, and “Again” resets it to 1 day. Today's due entries are listed here, oldest first.

manage.foundation.title: Setup · foundation
manage.foundation.lead: The shelf is built on xovi and qt-resource-rebuilder; install them on the device with vellum first (vellum add xovi, vellum add qt-resource-rebuilder).
manage.modules.title: Shelf features
manage.modules.lead: Each feature can be turned on/off or uninstalled separately; missing ones are installed from your computer with the command shown. The gateway (this page) is always present.
manage.modules.helpSummary: What do the three states / toggle / uninstall / install mean? (click to expand)
manage.modules.help.states.dd:
Not installed nothing on the device yet → run the given command to install.
Installed · off present but not running in the background → the page can't show its features, click "Enable".
On running in the background → its features are usable (fonts/wallpapers under "Other", note features under "Notes").
manage.modules.help.toggle.dd: Disable only stops the background service: its features are unavailable on the page (the master library prompts you to enable it), but what's already taken effect keeps working — an installed font is still selectable in the reader, a wallpaper still shows; you just can't push/change it from the web anymore. Useful for hiding features you don't use and shrinking the exposed surface.
manage.modules.help.perf.dt: Does leaving everything on lag or drain the battery?
manage.modules.help.perf.dd: Hardly. The services sit blocked waiting for requests and only do work when you use the web page or an event arrives. No perceptible impact on reading or note-taking. Recommended to leave everything on unless you're sure you'll never use a given feature.
manage.modules.help.uninstall.dd: Removes that feature's program, systemd unit, and any injected files (qmd). Books/fonts/wallpapers etc. you've already transferred are kept. After uninstalling it disappears from the page; reinstall with the install command to bring it back. The gateway itself can't be disabled or uninstalled from the web — it's the host of this Manage page.
manage.modules.help.install.dt: Why isn't installing done from the web?
manage.modules.help.install.dd: Installing remounts the read-only system partition and writes systemd units, which is risky, so the page only shows the command: run it from the repository on your computer.
manage.modules.confirmUninstall: Uninstall {label}? Removes its service/unit/related qmd (user data is kept).
manage.modules.confirmAllOff: Disable every domain service (keep the gateway)?
manage.models.title: Models
manage.models.lead: Cloud models used by the notes line for transcribing annotations (vision model) and Ask AI (text model). Pick a preset combination — no need to fill in a service address yourself; a type with no key configured just won't be usable for its feature.
manage.enhance.hlSnap.title: CJK highlight snapping
manage.enhance.hlSnap.desc: When highlighting Chinese, snaps only to the characters you marked instead of grabbing the whole line. Read on every stroke, so changes apply immediately.
manage.lab.importMd.title: Import md file
manage.lab.importMd.desc: When on, the Notes tab shows an “Import md” sub-tab (upload a .md to create a device notebook). Off by default.
manage.lab.review.title: Note review
manage.lab.review.desc: Adds a “Review” sub-tab to Notes: reviewed entries come back at spaced intervals, and you can make a “今日回顾” notebook on the device.

manage.enhance.pageTurn.title: xochitl reader page turns
manage.enhance.pageTurn.desc: Only affects xochitl's built-in reader and is off by default; it is read when a book is opened, so reopen the book after changing it.
manage.enhance.pageTurn.tapHint: Tap the left or right edge (about 7% wide, 35%–75% of the screen height) to turn pages: right edge = next, left edge = previous. Elsewhere taps work as usual (double-tap for text, links).
health.title: Device health
health.lead: A read-only check-up: data is collected only when you open this screen or press Refresh, never sampled in the background. Tap a badge for details.
health.refusedTitle: These extensions are installed but did not recognise this firmware at startup, so they did not load and their features are off (usually after a system update changed the code they look for). They need an update for the new firmware.
health.deletedTitle: xochitl is still running the old copy of these extensions (marked (deleted) in its memory map). The new files take effect after a device reboot; don't restart xochitl on its own (it may crash while exiting)
health.soPendingTitle: ~/.cangjie-stage/so-pending/ holds new .so files (xochitl was using the old ones at deploy time); they are swapped in automatically on the next device reboot
health.fw.pending: Computing (runs once, 30 s after the gateway starts)
health.extClean: No extension is waiting on a reboot, and nothing is staged to be swapped in.
health.fw.unknownTitle: The sha256 of /usr/bin/xochitl is not in packaging/firmware-allowlist.txt as built into the gateway: the firmware may have just been updated, or the suite was installed on new firmware with --force
health.servicesHint: "Up at … after boot" is when the service last became active; the duration includes pre-start steps. If a service was restarted after boot, these numbers are for that restart.
health.restartsTitle: How many times systemd has restarted this service since boot
health.prevBoot: Last 20 log lines from the previous boot
health.prevBootNone: Not available: the device journal is not persistent (kept in memory only), so the previous boot's log is gone after a restart.
health.deploy.none: No deployment record (this device hasn't been deployed with the deploy scripts from 10-14 or later)
health.deploy.dirtyTitle: The working tree on the computer had uncommitted changes, so what was installed is not exactly this commit
health.deploy.driftHint: Something replaced these files after the deployment (a single deploy script, a manual copy, a vellum upgrade), or that deployment didn't finish. Deploying again brings them back in line.
health.deploy.state.pending: new version waiting (takes effect after a reboot)
selftest.title: Self-test
selftest.lead: Runs the device-side operations the shelf relies on, for real, in the xochitl library: create a folder, create a subfolder inside it, add a one-page test book and wait for it to be laid out, then move everything to the trash. Takes about 1–3 minutes; “Add” requests from the web page wait in line meanwhile.
selftest.confirm: This temporarily creates a “书架自检 …” folder and a test book in the library, then moves them to the xochitl trash (you can empty the trash on the device afterwards). Run now?
selftest.step.mkdir-root: Create a temporary folder at the library root
selftest.step.upload-claim: Add the test book to the subfolder
selftest.step.render: Wait for xochitl to lay it out

agentfail.hint: The on-device agent tried 5 times without success and has stopped retrying. You can do it by hand on the device; if the xochitl library is in a bad state, reboot the device and try again from this page.
wifi.banner.portal: The device's WiFi “{ssid}” needs a web login first and has no internet access

wifi.banner.why: On such a network xochitl retries the cloud every few dozen seconds and each attempt hangs for half a minute, so the device stays awake and the battery drains noticeably faster. This page keeps working.
wifi.banner.hint: A web login cannot be completed on the reMarkable. If you don't need cloud sync, turn WiFi off on the device or switch to a phone hotspot.

cleanup.lib.desc: There is no reliable rule for spotting duplicate copies, so nothing is pre-selected; this lists the EPUB / PDF books in the library for you to check (notebooks are not listed). Selected books go through xochitl's own “Move to trash” and can be restored from the xochitl trash.
